2  ORDER
Petitioners are the land owners of different extent of agricultural lands situated at Mallenahalli Village, Dudda Hobli, Mandya Taluk and District, the details of which are as follows:

Sl. Petitioner Sy. No. Extent of land No. 1 1st petitioner 95 0.09 guntas 2 2nd petitioner 78/1C 0.09 guntas 3 3rd petitioner 64/2 0.04 guntas 4 4th petitioner 64/5 & 64/1 0.2.1/2 & 0.12 guntas 5 5th Petitioner 7/2 0.13 guntas 2.

The petitioners have filed the present petition seeking for a direction to the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Hemavathi Left Bank Channel, to consider the petitioners' applications under Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act (for short 'the Act') and to re-determine the value of the lands as per the award passed by the NC: 2023:KHC:21052 Principal Senior Civil Judge & CJM,
Mandya, in LAC No. 122/2007 dated 12.12.2022.
3.
Petitioners state that their lands were notified for acquisition for formation of "Hemavathi Left Bank Channel" as per notification dated 17.08.2000.

It is submitted that the similarly situated land owners in Mallenahalli Village, whose land was acquired under the same notification, had filed LAC No.122/2007 for enhancement of compensation and the said petition was allowed by fixing the compensation at Rs.8,820/- per gunta, apart from extending other statutory benefits.
4.

The present petitioners whose lands are situated in the same village state that they have made out representations at Annexures-B to B4 seeking for re-determination of the compensation by virtue of Section 28-A of the Act.

5. Taking note of the compensation granted in LAC No.122/2007, in terms of Section 28-A of the Act, the NC: 2023:KHC:21052 petition for re-determination of compensation is required to be made within a period of 3 months from the date of award of the Court.

As it is noticed that the order in LAC No.122/2007 came to be passed on 12.12.2022 and the applications have been made before the competent authority on 07.01.2023 within the time prescribed, petition is required to be allowed.
6. Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Respondents 1 and 2 to take appropriate decision on the applications of the petitioners at Annexures-B to B4 seeking re-determination under Section 28-A of the Act in accordance with law.
The said decision to be taken within a period of 3 months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
7. Accordingly, petition is disposed off.
